title: Christmas Gift Tag Ornament SVG Bundle
author: WoodNova
description:
Description :
Add a festive touch to your Christmas decorating and gift giving with this adorable Christmas Gift Tag SVG Bundle! This collection features six charming holiday tag designs with cute Christmas characters, snowy details, festive patterns, and colorful seasonal accents.
The designs are perfect for creating Christmas ornaments, gift tags, tree decorations, holiday shelf decor, personalized gifts, stocking decorations, craft fair products, and DIY laser-cut projects.
📁 File Formats Included
SVG
AI
EPS
DXF
DWG
PDF
⚙️ Compatible With
Glowforge, xTool, LightBurn, OMTech, Thunder Laser, Aeon Laser, Cricut, Silhouette Designer Edition, and most cutting machines/software that support SVG or DXF files.
